attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 228300)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Remember_Me
Fandom (rememberme.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://rememberme.fandom.com/wiki/Remember_Me
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4000); RAWG also lists "Capcom U.S.A" and "CurnurX" among the developers. Steam app 228300 is used; its schema is named "ValveTestApp228300" (a placeholder name), and a different, newer app 3999290 shares the title. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but no subpages exist. rememberme.fandom.com answers the API under "Remember Me", with about 84 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 5 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden. Their unlock rates sit close to episode completions, so "Medical malpractice" (66.8%, near "Finish episode 1") was placed in the first story chapter and the other four (26 to 36%) in the second; this is a reasoned guess from percentages only. The boss feats (Kid X-Mas, Madame) stay in the combat chapter because the data does not say which episode they belong to.
